outlook.statement: Because of prevailing market conditions, LPG business is not picking up inspite of best efforts and in future, business is not likely to pick up due to availability of PNG in the area.
The commercial and Industrial LPG consumption is likely to increase with the growing economic activities in the country.

risks: Availability of PNG in the area affecting LPG business pickup
